name: Espresso Roast
description: A bold and rich espresso with intense flavor and a smooth finish.
health_benefit: Boosts energy, improves mental focus, and contains antioxidants.
making_process: Brewed by forcing hot water through finely-ground coffee beans under high pressure.
serving_suggestion: Best served as a shot or with steamed milk for a latte.

name: Cappuccino
description: A classic Italian coffee with a perfect balance of espresso, steamed milk, and foam.
health_benefit: Rich in calcium and antioxidants; can improve digestion.
making_process: Prepared by mixing one-third espresso, one-third steamed milk, and one-third milk foam.
serving_suggestion: Sprinkle cocoa powder or cinnamon on top.

name: Cold Brew
description: Smooth, refreshing, and naturally sweet cold brew coffee made by steeping beans for 12 hours.
health_benefit: Gentle on the stomach, lower acidity, helps with hydration.
making_process: Ground beans steeped in cold water for 12–18 hours, then filtered.
serving_suggestion: Serve over ice with milk or sweetener.

name: Latte
description: A creamy coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk.
health_benefit: Good source of calcium and antioxidants.
making_process: Made by pouring steamed milk over a shot of espresso.
serving_suggestion: Add flavored syrups like vanilla or caramel.

name: Mocha
description: A sweet blend of espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk topped with whipped cream.
health_benefit: Provides antioxidants from cocoa and coffee.
making_process: Espresso mixed with chocolate syrup and steamed milk, topped with whipped cream.
serving_suggestion: Add a drizzle of chocolate or caramel syrup.

name: Iced Americano
description: A chilled version of the Americano with espresso shots poured over cold water and ice.
making_process: Espresso shots poured over cold water and ice.
